name: Jax became a revenant under Quan Chi
notes: Mortal Kombat X's Jax biography states that after he died in the Earthrealm fighting, Quan Chi confiscated his soul and recreated him as a vengeful undead warrior forced to fight against Earthrealm. Jacqui's biography also describes Jax's later experiences as a revenant in Quan Chi's service. This later-primary evidence formalizes the state without rewriting the earlier MK9 death and soul-control records.
